# MangaDex Extension Comparison: Houdoku vs Tachiyomi (v1.4.211)

Below is a detailed field-by-field breakdown of what metadata each extension extracts for a given MangaDex title.

---

## 1. Title Resolution

| Aspect | Houdoku (`index.ts`) | Tachiyomi (`MangaDexHelper.kt`) |
|---|---|---|
| **Primary title** |  only; falls back to first available title value | Extension language first, then main title, then English — configurable via `preferExtensionLangTitle` setting |
| **Alt titles considered** | Only  alt titles | Alt titles matching extension language **and** romanized original language (, , ) |
| **Romanized titles** | ❌ Not considered | ✅ Checks // when matching alt titles |

**Houdoku misses:** Non-English titles for non-English extensions, romanized Japanese/Korean/Chinese alt titles.

---

## 2. Cover Art

| Aspect | Houdoku | Tachiyomi |
|---|---|---|
| **Quality options** | ❌ Hardcoded to `.512.jpg` | ✅ Configurable: Original, Medium (`.512.jpg`), Low (`.256.jpg`) |
| **First volume cover** | ❌ Not supported | ✅ Optional — fetches from `POST /cover` endpoint by volume asc, filtered by original language locale |
| **CDN URL** | Configurable (`uploadsBaseUrl` setting) | Hardcoded to `https://uploads.mangadex.org` |

**Houdoku misses:** Cover quality choice, first volume cover fallback.

---

## 3. Description

| Aspect | Houdoku | Tachiyomi |
|---|---|---|
| **Language** | Only  | Extension language first, fallback to English |
| **HTML entities** | ❌ Not decoded (`&hearts;` stays as-is) | ✅ Decoded via `Parser.unescapeEntities()` |
| **Markdown removal** | ❌ Raw markdown kept | ✅ Strips links , bold/italic , `_text_` |
| **Alt titles appended** | ❌ | ✅ Optional (`altTitlesInDesc` setting) |
| **Final chapter appended** | ❌ | ✅ Optional (`finalChapterInDesc` setting) — shows `Vol.X Ch.Y` |
| **Trimming** | ❌ | ✅ Trims `\n---` separator and trailing whitespace |

**Houdoku misses:** Non-English descriptions, HTML decoding, markdown cleanup, optional appended alt titles and final chapter info.

---

## 4. Authors & Artists

| Aspect | Houdoku | Tachiyomi |
|---|---|---|
| **Authors** | ✅ From `author` relationships | ✅ From `AuthorDto` relationships, deduplicated |
| **Artists** | ✅ From `artist` relationships | ✅ From `ArtistDto` relationships, deduplicated |
| **Format** | Array of strings | Comma-joined string |

Both extract the same data. Tachiyomi deduplicates; Houdoku does not.

---

## 5. Tags / Genres

| Aspect | Houdoku | Tachiyomi |
|---|---|---|
| **Tag source** |  (English only) |  in extension language via i18n |
| **Organization** | Flat array | Grouped: **Content** → **Format** → **Genre** → **Theme** (ordered) |
| **Publication demographic** | Added as a raw tag string | ✅ Localized label (e.g., "Shounen", "Shoujo") |
| **Content rating label** | ❌ Not included | ✅ Added as "Content rating: Safe/Suggestive/Erotica/Pornographic" (only if not Safe) |
| **Original language display** | Only as ISO code | ✅ Display name localized to extension language (e.g., "Japanese", "Korean") |
| **Tag localization** | ❌ English only | ✅ Translated via `messages_*.properties` i18n files |

**Houdoku misses:** Localized tag names, organized groups, content rating label, localized original language display name, properly localized demographic.

---

## 6. Status Detection

| Aspect | Houdoku | Tachiyomi |
|---|---|---|
| **Basic mapping** | , , ,  | Same basic mapping via `StatusDto` |
| **One-shot detection** | ❌ | ✅ Checks for oneshot tag (`0234a31e...`) AND absence of anthology tag (`51d83883...`) |
| **Completed detection** | ❌ | ✅ Checks if `lastChapter` actually exists in chapter list (via aggregate endpoint) |
| **Aggregate endpoint** | ❌ Not used | ✅ Calls `/manga/{id}/aggregate` to verify chapter existence for status |

**Houdoku misses:** One-shot status detection, verified completed status.

---

## 7. Chapter List

| Aspect | Houdoku | Tachiyomi |
|---|---|---|
| **Pagination** | 500 per page | 500 per page |
| **Scanlator group** | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Uploader fallback** | ❌ (empty string if no group) | ✅ Shows "Uploaded by {username}" if no group, "No Group" as final fallback |
| **Unavailable chapters** | Always included | ✅ Optional — toggleable `includeUnavailable` setting, prefixed with "UNAVAILABLE - " |
| **Group blocking** | ❌ | ✅ Block by comma-separated UUIDs; also blocks known official groups (Azuki, Bilibili, Comikey, INKR, Manga Hot, Manga Plus) by default |
| **Uploader blocking** | ❌ | ✅ Block by comma-separated UUIDs |
| **Chapter name format** | Simple:  | Structured: `Vol.X Ch.Y - Title` (or "Oneshot" if all empty) |
| **Date field** |  |  |
| **Content rating filter** | Always includes ALL ratings in feed request | Configurable default content rating (default: Safe + Suggestive only) |

**Houdoku misses:** Uploader name fallback, unavailable chapter handling, group/uploader blocking, structured chapter naming, configurable content rating for feed, uses  instead of `publishAt`.

---

## 8. Page / Image Loading

| Aspect | Houdoku | Tachiyomi |
|---|---|---|
| **At-home endpoint** | ✅ `/at-home/server/{chapterId}` | ✅ `/at-home/server/{chapterId}` |
| **Data saver** | ✅ Toggle between  and  | ✅ Toggle between  and  |
| **MD@Home token tracking** | ❌ | ✅ Tracks token lifespan (5 min), re-requests when expired, caches tokens |
| **HTTPS port 443 only** | ❌ | ✅ Optional `forcePort443=true` for strict firewalls |
| **Image caching headers** | ❌ | ✅ Uses `CacheControl` with max-stale for cached tokens |

**Houdoku misses:** MD@Home token expiration handling, HTTPS port restriction, sophisticated caching.

---

## 9. Search Capabilities

| Aspect | Houdoku | Tachiyomi |
|---|---|---|
| **Text search** | ✅ Basic title search | ✅ Title search |
| **ID search** ( prefix) | ❌ | ✅ Direct UUID lookup |
| **Chapter→Manga** (`ch:` prefix) | ❌ | ✅ Resolves chapter UUID to manga |
| **Group search** (`grp:` prefix) | ❌ | ✅ Search by scanlation group UUID |
| **Author search** (`author:` prefix) | ❌ | ✅ Search by author UUID |
| **Uploader search** (`usr:` prefix) | ❌ | ✅ Shows latest chapters by uploader |
| **List search** (`list:` prefix) | ❌ | ✅ Browse a MangaDex custom list |
| **URL detection** | ❌ | ✅ Parses `mangadex.org` URLs and converts to prefix searches |
| **Popular browsing** | Falls back to empty search | ✅ Dedicated `popularManga` endpoint sorted by `followedCount` |
| **Latest updates** | ❌ | ✅ Dedicated `latestUpdates` endpoint sorted by `publishAt` (desc) |

**Houdoku misses:** All prefix-based searches, URL auto-detection, popular manga browsing, latest updates feed.

---

## 10. Filter Options

| Filter | Houdoku | Tachiyomi |
|---|---|---|
| **Has available chapters** | ✅ Checkbox | ✅ Checkbox + auto-adds `availableTranslatedLanguage[]` |
| **Sort** | ✅ 8 sort fields with asc/desc | ✅ 8 sort fields with asc/desc (same set) |
| **Formats** | ✅ 12 formats (TriState) | ✅ 12 formats (TriState) — localized names |
| **Genres** | ✅ 23 genres (TriState) | ✅ 23 genres (TriState) — localized names |
| **Themes** | ✅ 38 themes (TriState) | ✅ 38 themes (TriState) — localized names |
| **Content Warnings** | ✅ 2 (Gore, Sexual Violence) (TriState) | ✅ 2 (Gore, Sexual Violence) (TriState) |
| **Content Rating** | ✅ 4 ratings (MultiToggle) | ✅ 4 ratings (Checkbox group) — persisted across sessions |
| **Original Language** | ✅ 4 (Japanese, Korean, Chinese, English) | ✅ 3 (Japanese, Chinese, Korean) — persisted, no English option |
| **Demographic** | ✅ 5 (None, Shounen, Shoujo, Seinen, Josei) | ✅ 5 (same, localized) |
| **Status** | ✅ 4 (Ongoing, Completed, Hiatus, Cancelled) | ✅ 4 (same, localized) |
| **Tags mode (AND/OR)** | ✅ Included + Excluded mode selectors | ✅ Included + Excluded mode selectors (same) |
| **Tag sorting** | ❌ (hardcoded order) | ✅ Alphabetically sorted when using non-English UI language |

**Equivalent on filters** — both expose the same set. Tachiyomi localizes filter labels; Houdoku uses hardcoded English.

## Summary: What Houdoku Cannot Obtain (But Tachiyomi Can)

1. **Non-English titles, descriptions, alt titles, and tag names**
2. **Localized demographic, content rating, and original language labels in genre list**
3. **One-shot and verified-completed status detection**
4. **Uploader name as fallback when no scanlation group**
5. **Unavailable chapter visibility control**
6. **Group/uploader blocking by UUID**
7. **MD@Home token expiration handling (5-min window)**
8. **Cover quality options and first-volume cover fallback**
9. **HTML entity decoding and markdown stripping in descriptions**
10. **Optional alt titles and final chapter appended to description**
11. **Prefix-based searches (id:, ch:, grp:, author:, usr:, list:)**
12. **Popular manga and latest updates browsing**
13. **Configurable default content rating and original language filters**
14. **Ordered/grouped tags (Content → Format → Genre → Theme)**

## Summary: What Tachiyomi Cannot Do (But Houdoku Can)

1. **Configurable API and CDN base URLs** (Tachiyomi hardcodes `api.mangadex.org` / `uploads.mangadex.org`)
2. **English as a filterable original language option**
3. **Import from Tachiyomi backup format** (Houdoku has explicit import support)
